title: ::: K-IG 교육 영어듣기훈련프로그램 | 기초2 | 제 001 회 강의 :::
label: [ K-IG 교육 Reading 074 ]

blocks.text: "They say best men are molded out of faults," wrote Shakespeare in Measure for Measure, "and, for the most part, become much more the better for being a little bad." Thus, each mistake can be seen as a prime opportunity for self-improvement. Indeed, the bigger the bunder, the better its chance of helping you become a better person ― if you know how to make amends.

readingSentences.english: "They say best men are molded out of faults," wrote Shakespeare in Measure for Measure, "and, for the most part, become much more the better for being a little bad."
readingSentences.korean: “가장 최고의 인물들은 실수로부터 형성되고, 또한 대체로 상당히 나쁘기 때문에 그만큼 더 좋은 사람이 된다고 사람들은 말한다."라고 셰익스피어는 Measure for Measure에 적고 있다.

readingSentences.english: Thus, each mistake can be seen as a prime opportunity for self-improvement.
readingSentences.korean: 그리하여, 각각의 실수는 자기 개선을 위한 주요한 기회로 간주될 수 있다.

readingSentences.english: Indeed, the bigger the bunder, the better its chance of helping you become a better person ― if you know how to make amends.
readingSentences.korean: 진정으로, 실수가 크면 클수록, 일단 당신이 실수를 보충하는 법을 알기만 한다면, 당신이 보다 좋은 사람이 되게 도와줄 가능성은 더 커진다.
